question: If the glomerular filtration rate is 125 ml / min and the plasma clearance of an "X" substance is 80 ml / min, the substance "X":
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Glomerular filtration rate is 125 ml/min" -> "Plasma clearance of substance X is 80 ml/min" -> "Plasma clearance is less than GFR" -> "Substance X is reabsorbed" -> "Substance X is filtered and reabsorbed" -> 85%

CHAIN: "Glomerular filtration rate is 125 ml/min" -> "Plasma clearance of substance X is 80 ml/min" -> "Plasma clearance indicates net handling of substance" -> "Substance X is not only filtered" -> "Substance X is filtered and reabsorbed" -> 90%

CHAIN: "Glomerular filtration rate is 125 ml/min" -> "Plasma clearance of substance X is 80 ml/min" -> "Clearance lower than GFR suggests reabsorption" -> "Substance X is filtered" -> "Substance X is filtered and reabsorbed" -> 80%

CHAIN: "Glomerular filtration rate is 125 ml/min" -> "Plasma clearance of substance X is 80 ml/min" -> "Clearance indicates some handling by nephron" -> "Substance X is filtered" -> "Substance X is filtered and possibly reabsorbed" -> 75%
analysis: The plasma clearance of substance 'X' is lower than the glomerular filtration rate (GFR). This indicates that some of the substance is being reabsorbed back into the bloodstream after filtration, as the clearance is not sufficient to account for the total amount filtered. Therefore, substance 'X' is filtered and reabsorbed.
